title: Bram and the Crown
author: Isandro Eastwick
blurb: Rosalind Almeida, the youngest member of a dying guild, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
